comment: Whether CardinalCommerce 3-D Secure requests use the sandbox or production environment.
modal: Selects the CardinalCommerce target: **Sandbox** for testing or **Production** for live transactions. Applies only when the CardinalCommerce integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

comment: The CardinalCommerce Org Unit ID used to authenticate 3-D Secure requests.
modal: The Org Unit ID credential issued by CardinalCommerce for the Cardinal Cruise API. Stored encrypted. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

comment: The CardinalCommerce API key used to authenticate 3-D Secure requests.
modal: The API key credential issued by CardinalCommerce. Stored encrypted. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

comment: The CardinalCommerce API Identifier used to authenticate 3-D Secure requests.
modal: The API Identifier credential issued by CardinalCommerce. Stored encrypted. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether CardinalCommerce request and response details are written to the debug log.
modal: When **Yes**, CardinalCommerce communication is logged for troubleshooting. Applies only when the integration is enabled. Can differ per website.
